end.summary:
Discussed “unity in diversity” and “many in the one.”
Used music, guitar notes/chords, festivals, food, clothes, and seasonal celebrations as examples.
Riya explained that differences can coexist and enrich shared life.
Unaided correct responses: 2; teach-back was not passed.
Riya said they were tired and requested a game near the end.
end.parentNote: Riya practised explaining unity in diversity through familiar examples such as different instruments making music, varied festivals sharing common purposes, and different foods and clothing. The comparison method worked well, especially when they connected guitar sounds and harvest celebrations to the idea that differences can exist together. No recorded mix-up remained at the end. At home, ask Riya to compare two festivals by naming one difference and one shared purpose.
